run_unconditional_image_generation_gaudi: run unconditional image generation using a DDPM model on Intel Gaudi HPU hardware
run_gaudi_ddim_scheduler: run unconditional image generation using the Gaudi optimized DDIM scheduler instead of DDPM
run_bf16_image_generation: run unconditional image generation with bf16 precision for improved performance on Gaudi
run_hpu_graphs_inference: run unconditional image generation using HPU graphs for lower latency inference
save_generated_images: run unconditional image generation and save the output images as jpg files to a directory
